name_reason: Prefix data_fd2_battle_ is correct (battle-domain compositor global). Descriptor compose_parallax_scroll_y_rows accurately reflects: written during walk-step composite passes, consumed by fd2_composite_battle_tile_map in all background-drawing branches (including parallax chapters 0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B), Y axis, unit = rows. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix matching its own/any address); 'y' is the axis and 'rows' the unit, both semantic. Datatype (a scalar row count) is reflected by the descriptor.
purpose: Top-margin Y-row count for the scroll-up battle tile-map composite; converted to a Y byte offset (value * 0x1C8 row stride) added into the background-blit base.
logic_summary: WRITER fd2_walk_step_up sets it to 0x18 (24) just before each scroll-up composite pass (render from lower workspace +0x55C8 with a +1 top-margin row) and clears it to 0 right after, so the static (non-animating) image uses 0. READER fd2_composite_battle_tile_map computes value*0x1C8 (456 = row byte stride) and adds the result into the background-blit base offset; this is applied in every chapter branch that draws a background (animated 9/0x18/0x19/0x1C/0x1D, extra-wide parallax 0x11/0x15/0x16/0x1B, text-screen 0x17). The default no-background chapter branch never reads it.
element_semantics: Single dword: a top-margin row count (0x18 during scroll-up pass, else 0). Multiplied by 0x1C8 (row byte stride) to yield the Y byte offset added into the background-blit base.
notes: BSS/zero-init in .object2 (memory reads all zeros). 2 WRITE xrefs from fd2_walk_step_up (0x132b3, 0x132e6) and 3 READ xrefs from fd2_composite_battle_tile_map (0x11fcf, 0x1208a, 0x120f1) -> has game writers, NOT const. Definition lives in home file aniwalk.c line 766 with its descriptive comment block at lines 756-765 (declaration in src/include/globals.h, usage in src/gfx/rndscene.c). src comment block is already precise, accurate and ASCII-clean; Ghidra data plate is detailed and consistent with the src understanding (writer 0x18, reader IMUL 0x1C8, all chapter branches, not const). No src or plate change required; keep/keep.
